description: This file implements the CoarseGrainedSchedulerBackend class, a scheduler backend for Apache Spark that manages coarse-grained executors, handles executor registration, decommissioning, resource requests, and communication with executors via RPC. It also manages security tokens, executor lifecycle, and resource offers.

classes.name: CoarseGrainedSchedulerBackend
classes.description: A scheduler backend for Spark that manages coarse-grained executors, handles registration, decommissioning, resource requests, and executor lifecycle management.

classes.name: DriverEndpoint
classes.description: An RPC endpoint class within CoarseGrainedSchedulerBackend that handles communication with executors, including registration, status updates, task management, and control commands.

methods.name: decommissionExecutors
methods.description: Requests the cluster manager to decommission specified executors, optionally adjusting target executor count and triggering decommission at executor.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the backend, including security token setup if enabled.

methods.name: stopExecutors
methods.description: Shuts down all executors by sending StopExecutors message.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the backend, including threads, executors, and security tokens.

methods.name: updateExecutorsLogLevel
methods.description: Requests all executors to update their log level.

methods.name: requestExecutors
methods.description: Requests additional executors from the cluster manager.

methods.name: requestTotalExecutors
methods.description: Requests the total number of executors per resource profile, including locality-aware tasks and host task counts.

methods.name: killExecutors
methods.description: Requests the cluster manager to kill specified executors, optionally adjusting target executor count.

methods.name: decommissionExecutorsOnHost
methods.description: Requests decommissioning of all executors on a specified host.

methods.name: killExecutorsOnHost
methods.description: Requests killing of all executors on a specified host.

methods.name: getExecutorIds
methods.description: Returns a sequence of current executor IDs.

methods.name: getExecutorsWithRegistrationTs
methods.description: Returns a map of executor IDs to their registration timestamps.

methods.name: isExecutorActive
methods.description: Checks if an executor is active and not pending removal or decommission.

methods.name: isReady
methods.description: Determines if the backend is ready for scheduling based on resource registration.

methods.name: getExecutorAvailableResources
methods.description: Returns available resources info for a given executor (testing only).

methods.name: getExecutorAvailableCpus
methods.description: Returns available CPU cores for a given executor (testing only).

methods.name: getExecutorResourceProfileId
methods.description: Returns the resource profile ID for a given executor (testing only).

methods.name: killTask
methods.description: Sends a command to kill a specific task on an executor.

methods.name: getTaskThreadDump
methods.description: Retrieves thread dump for a task running on an executor.
